name: combly
description: MCP connector for Combly: load, search and export YouTube, TikTok and Instagram comments and draw fair giveaway winners.
long_description: Find, search and export YouTube, TikTok and Instagram comments, and draw fair giveaway winners. get_account reads your plan and usage. load_comments and search_comments read a post's comments and find them by keyword, author, date, questions or links; export_comments returns CSV. draw_giveaway picks random winners under your rules and publishes a winner page; list_giveaways and get_giveaway read past draws. Loads and draws use your plan's monthly limits.
